title: [dev] Manual profile switches sent twice to pump
body:
It seems to be a recent bug...

At 3:00:48 I installed a previous built done after https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/081e8bd684632cfa795b68dd623f9663fe962d2d (10/11 9h24) and PS is sent twice to pump

Then I installed at 3:05:42 an older built done after https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/22fced61fe72870f9891d2a9cada081a8d5244eb (08/11 13:37) and PS was sent only once to pump

Just one trial it can be luck...
